title: A Data-Driven Closed-Loop Control Approach to Drive Neural State Transitions for Mechanistic Insight.
qc_rationale: Individual fMRI time series train nonlinear dynamical-system-reconstruction models of resting and sad-mood brain states; optimal-control rollouts directly evaluate target-state convergence, trajectory likelihood, and control energy.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods on DSR and optimal control; Results and Figures 3-4 on generated controlled trajectories, target NLL, and control-energy comparisons.

title: A Neurosymbolic Approach for Constructing Planning Domain Models from Clinical Narratives
qc_rationale: From 2,660 appendectomy narratives, NSPIN learns PPDDL action preconditions, probabilistic effects, and a data-driven next-action transition model; held-out observation and action prediction are evaluated with top-k accuracy, NLL, and true-action-disallowed rate.
full_text_anchor: Primary arXiv full text, Data-Driven Induction and evaluation Tables 1-3 on learned PPDDL effects and held-out transition prediction.

title: Human–Machine Co-Adaptation for Robot-Assisted Rehabilitation via Dual-Agent Multiple Model Reinforcement Learning (DAMMRL)
qc_rationale: The rehabilitation environment uses designable PD/PID human and machine subcontrollers plus a hand-built Simulink robot; neural networks learn submodel-switching policies, not a patient or robot transition mechanism from observed data.
full_text_anchor: Full arXiv text states that the submodels are designable and parameterized, while PPO learns adaptive switching; subject experiments evaluate control behavior rather than learned dynamics.

title: Learning Dynamic Representations and Policies from Multimodal Clinical Time-Series with Informative Missingness
qc_rationale: MIMIC and eICU trajectories train an action-conditioned latent transition p(z[h+1] | z[h], phi[h], a[h]) with a dynamics-consistency loss; treatment policies using that state model are evaluated by FQE, bootstrap checks, and cross-dataset transfer.
full_text_anchor: ACL full text, Section 3.1.2 VAE transition equation and Section 4 plus appendices reporting FQE and cross-dataset policy evaluation.

title: MicroVerse: A Preliminary Exploration Toward a Micro-World Simulation
qc_rationale: The model is fine-tuned on public educational microscopy-style videos and evaluated for visual and instruction fidelity; it does not learn a transition for an observed medical or biomedical system and explicitly does not reproduce wet-lab dynamics.
full_text_anchor: ICLR 2026 full text, dataset construction and Limitation section stating that biomedical physical laws are not modeled and wet-lab results are not reproduced.

title: T-World Virtual Human Cardiomyocyte. I. Development, Validation, and Cell Arrhythmogenesis.
qc_rationale: T-World is a manually assembled system of biophysical ODE modules adapted from prior cardiomyocyte models, with selected parameters optimized to experimental targets; the transition law itself is not learned or adapted from observed state sequences.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods describes hand-constructed ionic-current, calcium, signaling, and contraction equations followed by component-level parameter optimization.

title: A Bayesian mixture model for Poisson network autoregression.
qc_rationale: Bayesian Poisson network-autoregressive coefficients and county clusters are inferred from weekly Irish COVID-19 counts, defining a learned next-week count transition; week-25 leave-future-out forecasts and predictive calibration are directly evaluated.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Sections 3 and 5, posterior predictive equation for Y[T+1], week-25 MASE comparison, and randomized-PIT calibration analysis.

title: A Novel Model for Generating Patient Laboratory Test Orders from Admission: Transformer Model Approach
qc_rationale: GPT-2 learns the sequence of clinicians' laboratory-order tokens from admission to discharge, but the generated process is an ordering workflow rather than an evolving patient physiological, pathological, cellular, or device state.
full_text_anchor: Primary proceedings abstract and methods describe tokenized laboratory-order generation and F-score evaluation, with no modeled patient-state transition or physiological rollout.

title: GeneJepa: A Predictive World Model of the Transcriptome
qc_rationale: GeneJepa predicts masked gene-set embeddings within single-cell transcriptomic snapshots and transfers representations to drug-response and perturbation endpoints; it does not learn or evaluate baseline-to-future cellular state evolution or recursive rollout.
full_text_anchor: Primary bioRxiv text describes JEPA masked-gene latent prediction and downstream perturbation benchmarks, without a temporal or action-conditioned state-transition experiment.

title: Integrating Process Mining and Machine Learning for Surgical Workflow Optimization: A Real-World Analysis Using the MOVER EHR Dataset
qc_rationale: The study discovers a descriptive Petri-net workflow and trains a Random Forest for delayed-recovery classification; neither component learns a forward clinical-state transition or evaluates generated future workflow trajectories.
full_text_anchor: Full article methods and results report heuristic control-flow discovery, conformance scores, clustering, and a delayed-recovery endpoint classifier only.

title: Physiology-Guided Blood Glucose Predictive Model Using Minimal Blood Glucose Dynamics
qc_rationale: The learned model predicts one isolated glucose value 30 minutes ahead, while insulin and meal dynamics are fixed analytical input transformations; no learned next-state operator, trajectory rollout, or action-response transition is evaluated.
full_text_anchor: Proceedings full text, Methods equations 1-2 and Evaluation section defining only G(t+PH) at a 30-minute prediction horizon.

title: Short- and long-term weekly patient-reported outcomes prediction undergoing radiotherapy: single-patient time series model vs. transformer-based multi-patient time series model
qc_rationale: VAR and TFT models learn weekly multivariate patient-reported-outcome evolution from longitudinal radiotherapy data; short- and long-horizon weekly trajectories, trends, and variations are evaluated against ground truth with MAE and RMSE.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods on VAR, VAR-Inc, and TFT; Results on weekly trajectory prediction, long-horizon errors, and trend capture.

title: A Deep Learning-Enhanced Compartmental Model and Its Application in Modeling Omicron in China.
qc_rationale: DNN and LSTM components estimate time-varying compartmental transition parameters and the resulting 28-day epidemic trajectories are evaluated, but the only stable article version is in a source excluded by the review's evidence policy.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods and Results describe learned transmission parameters and 28-day infection/death prediction; exclusion is solely the established source-policy boundary.

title: A mini-review on perturbation modelling across single-cell omic modalities.
qc_rationale: The review centrally synthesizes learned single-cell perturbation-response models that predict intervention-driven changes in cellular physiology and dynamic cell state, including extrapolation to unseen perturbations and time-dependent responses.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Introduction and objectives O1-O4 define perturbation modeling as predicting external-intervention effects on dynamic cell states across time and modalities.

title: OMG-RL:Offline Model-based Guided Reward Learning for Heparin Treatment
qc_rationale: Clinical heparin trajectories train an ensemble probabilistic dynamics model of patient state under dosing actions; recursive model rollouts generate trajectories for reward and policy learning, followed by off-policy return and treatment-success evaluation.
full_text_anchor: Primary arXiv full text, Methods and Algorithm 2 on probabilistic dynamics-ensemble rollouts; Results Figures 3-7 on model-based returns and treatment success.

title: Structural and practical identifiability of contrast transport models for DCE-MRI.
qc_rationale: The Patlak, Tofts-Kety, extended Tofts, and leaky Tofts-Kety transition equations are pre-existing hand-specified compartmental models; patient data estimate parameters and identifiability but do not learn or adapt the transition mechanism.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods explicitly defines the fixed nested ODE compartment structures and evaluates parameter identifiability rather than a learned transition.

title: Structure-aware World Model for Probe Guidance via Large-scale Self-supervised Pre-train
qc_rationale: Paired echocardiographic planes and their pose changes train a model to predict target-plane features from a source plane and probe transformation; the learned spatial transition is operationally evaluated through six-degree-of-freedom probe-guidance error.
full_text_anchor: Primary full text, Figure 2 and equations 4-6 for pose-conditioned target prediction; Table 1 for downstream translation and rotation MAE.

title: BrainLM: A foundation model for brain activity recordings
qc_rationale: BrainLM learns spatiotemporal fMRI transitions by masked sequence prediction over 6,700 recording hours and directly evaluates forecasting of future brain-state blocks, including transfer to external cohorts.
full_text_anchor: Most complete ICLR 2024 paper and associated bioRxiv record, future-brain-state forecasting experiment and external-cohort evaluation.

title: Deep Dynamic Epidemiological Modelling for COVID-19 Forecasting in Multi-level Districts
qc_rationale: A neural parameter generator learns state-dependent epidemic rates from regional observations, and a Neural ODE repeatedly advances compartment states; 20-day trajectories are evaluated across countries and districts against recurrent and tree baselines.
full_text_anchor: Primary arXiv full text, system diagram and Neural ODE transition procedure; Results Figures 7 and Tables I-II on held-out 20-day trajectories.

title: Towards Model-Informed Precision Dosing of Voriconazole: Challenging Published Voriconazole Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Models with Real-World Clinical Data
qc_rationale: Published nonlinear mixed-effects concentration-time transitions are adapted to individual patients by Bayesian forecasting with observed drug levels; external concentration trajectories and simulation-based diagnostics directly test predictive fidelity.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record workflow and Methods on external NLME evaluation, Bayesian forecasting, prediction error, RMSE, and simulation-based diagnostics.

title: BeCaked: An Explainable Artificial Intelligence Model for COVID-19 Forecasting
qc_rationale: An LSTM learns time-varying SIRD transition parameters from historical epidemic series, and the resulting compartment trajectories are forecast and compared with real COVID-19 data and competing models.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record model section linking LSTM outputs to SIRD rates and performance section evaluating future epidemic trajectories.

title: Considerations in Bayesian agent-based modeling for the analysis of COVID-19 data
qc_rationale: The susceptible-infected agent transition rule and contact-network mechanism are specified a priori; particle MCMC estimates their parameters and hidden states but does not learn or adapt the transition law itself.
full_text_anchor: Primary arXiv full text, equations 2-3 and agent-based SIS section define fixed Bernoulli transition rules before Bayesian parameter inference.

title: Control of Magnetic Surgical Robots With Model-Based Simulators and Reinforcement Learning.
qc_rationale: Real magnetic-needle trajectories train a neural next-state dynamics model from needle state and coil action; the learned simulator trains controllers whose pressure-free motion trajectories are then evaluated in simulation and on the physical surgical robot.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods explicitly introduces neural model-based simulation learned from real-world data; experiments evaluate target-reaching control on MagnetoSuture hardware.

title: Machine learning and artificial intelligence in physiologically based pharmacokinetic modeling
qc_rationale: The review primarily covers ML prediction of static ADME inputs and PK summary endpoints for hand-specified PBPK models; learned time-series dynamics such as Neural ODEs are presented as a prospective opportunity rather than a central evaluated evidence category.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record abstract and review structure organize evidence around ADME-parameter and AUC/Cmax prediction, with direct Neural-ODE profile modeling identified as future work.

title: A Blood Glucose Control Framework Based on Reinforcement Learning With Safety and Interpretability: In Silico Validation
qc_rationale: Online RFR and dual-attention models learn 30-45-minute glucose transitions from glucose, insulin action, and meal histories; these predictions form extended states and safety triggers for SAC, with forecast and closed-loop trajectory evaluation in the UVA/Padova simulator.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Sections III-V: prediction-model equations, action-linked future-state definition, 30-minute forecast comparison, and 20-day closed-loop glucose-control trajectories.

title: Clinical-Based vs. Model-Based Adaptive Dosing Strategy: Retrospective Comparison in Real-World mRCC Patients Treated with Sunitinib
qc_rationale: The study retrospectively compares empirical dose changes with recommendations from an existing PK/PD model; it does not evaluate generated future patient-state trajectories, action responses, or simulator fidelity against subsequent outcomes.
full_text_anchor: Full article Results compare recommended dose categories and observed clinician decisions, without prospective or held-out longitudinal dynamics evaluation.

title: Machine Learning for Mechanical Ventilation Control
qc_rationale: State-action-pressure trajectories collected from a physical artificial lung train neural lung simulators; controllers optimized through those learned transitions are directly evaluated for multi-breath pressure-waveform tracking on held-out lung settings and hardware.
full_text_anchor: Primary arXiv full text, Sections 3-5 on physical data collection, learned simulator evaluation, and learned-controller pressure trajectories.

title: Phenotyping heart failure using model-based analysis and physiology-informed machine learning
qc_rationale: A pre-specified closed-loop cardiovascular ODE is tuned to cross-sectional catheterization and echocardiography summaries, then fitted parameters are clustered for phenotype discovery; no learned transition law or evolving future-state evaluation is provided.
full_text_anchor: Published PLOS Computational Biology version, model-calibration and clustering sections; evaluation is fit to hemodynamic summaries rather than temporal rollout fidelity.

title: A Novel, Enriched Population Pharmacokinetic Model for Recombinant Factor VIII-Fc Fusion Protein Concentrate in Hemophilia A Patients
qc_rationale: Registry concentration-time observations fit an enriched two-compartment nonlinear mixed-effects transition with learned covariate effects; external prediction error and internal visual predictive checks evaluate full FVIII concentration profiles.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods on NONMEM model development and covariate selection; Results Table 1, external validation, and visual predictive checks of concentration-time profiles.

title: Model‐Based Approach to Improve Clinical Outcomes in Neonates With Opioid Withdrawal Syndrome Using Real‐World Data
qc_rationale: Longitudinal neonatal symptom scores and morphine doses fit a dynamic mixed-effects transition with lagged symptom autocorrelation and dose response; held-out simulation evaluates symptom-course-derived treatment duration against observations.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods on the dynamic linear mixed-effects model and 70/30 split; test-set simulation comparing observed 13.0-day with predicted 13.8-day median treatment duration.

title: Real-World Implications of a Rapidly Responsive COVID-19 Spread Model with Time-Dependent Parameters via Deep Learning: Model Development and Validation
qc_rationale: Neural networks learn time-varying S, I, R, beta, and gamma functions from epidemic observations under SIR residual constraints; resulting state trajectories are numerically checked and cross-validated on Korea, Italy, Sweden, and the United States.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record Methods on five neural networks and forward-inverse training; Results on RK4 agreement and cross-country trajectory validation.

title: Second waves, social distancing, and the spread of COVID-19 across the USA.
qc_rationale: The 256-state regional epidemic transition graph, social-distancing response equations, and inter-state coupling structure are manually specified; variational Bayes fits parameters, but the medical transition mechanism itself is not learned or adapted from data.
full_text_anchor: Version-of-record model section and Figures 1-2 define fixed compartment states and transition arrows before Bayesian inversion and policy simulation.
